name: Aura: Manifest Will
descr:
Granted by [Manifest Will](/spell/manifest-will-war-of-immortals)

You emanate a 10-ft aura. If you have the [Multifaceted Will](/feat/multifaceted-will-war-of-immortals) feat, you can choose any tradition. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to saves against spells with that tradition trait.

name: Effect: A Challenge for Heroes (Ally)
descr:
Granted by [A Challenge For Heroes](/action/a-challenge-for-heroes-war-of-immortals)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the origin's level.

name: Effect: A Challenge for Heroes (Enemy)
descr:
Granted by [A Challenge For Heroes](/action/a-challenge-for-heroes-war-of-immortals)

You deal an additional 10 spirit damage to the exemplar with each successful Strike.

name: Effect: Abjure Harm
descr:
Granted by [Abjure Harm](/feat/abjure-harm-war-of-immortals)

You gain resistance to physical damage equal to your level.

name: Effect: Absolve Sins
descr:
Granted by [Absolve Sins](/feat/absolve-sins-war-of-immortals)

You use the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of your saving throw against Absolve Sins.

name: Effect: Aegis for the Innocent
descr:
Granted by [Aegis For The Innocent](/feat/aegis-for-the-innocent-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Apparition's Enhancement
descr:
Granted by [Apparition'S Enhancement](/feat/apparition-s-enhancement-war-of-immortals)

One wielded weapon or unarmed attack you have deals an extra 1d6 spirit damage.

name: Effect: Ascend
descr:
Granted by [Ascend](/feat/ascend-war-of-immortals)

Your fly speed becomes equal to double your Speed.

name: Effect: Ascended Celestial Nimbus
descr:
Granted by [Ascended Celestial Dedication](/feat/ascended-celestial-dedication-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against fear.

name: Effect: Bless Ally
descr:
Granted by [Bless Ally](/action/bless-ally-war-of-immortals)

You can roll twice and use the higher result for your next Will save.

name: Effect: Bloc Tactics
descr:
Granted by [Bloc Tactics](/feat/bloc-tactics-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you can add your level even if untrained. Additionally, you also gain a +3 status bonus to saving throws against smoke, fumes, and inhaled substances.

name: Effect: Celestial Armaments
descr:
Granted by [Celestial Armaments](/feat/celestial-armaments-war-of-immortals)

Your weapon sheds light like a torch, deals an additional 1d8 spirit damage, and you gain the weapon's critical specialization.

When you critically hit a target with the weapon, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) or be blinded for 1d4 rounds.

name: Effect: Celestial Armaments (Allies)
descr:
Granted by [Celestial Armaments](/feat/celestial-armaments-war-of-immortals)

Your weapon sheds light like a torch, deals an additional 1d6 spirit damage, and you gain the weapon's critical specialization.

name: Effect: Channel Divine Spark
descr:
Granted by [Channel Divine Spark](/feat/channel-divine-spark-war-of-immortals)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level, resistance to physical damage equal to half your level, and the [quickened](/condition/quickened-player-core) condition.

Each time that you damage a creature with a melee Strike, you can attempt to Shove or Trip that creature as a free action.

name: Effect: Channel the Godmind
descr:
Granted by [Channel The Godmind](/feat/channel-the-godmind-war-of-immortals)

You gain precise motion sense out to 60 feet.

name: Effect: Channeled Protection
descr:
Granted by [Channeled Protection](/feat/channeled-protection-war-of-immortals)

You gain a status bonus to your AC and to your Reflex saving throws.

name: Effect: Channeler's Stance
descr:
Granted by [Channeler'S Stance](/feat/channeler-s-stance-war-of-immortals)

Whenever you cast or Sustain an apparition spell or vessel spell that deals energy damage, you gain a status bonus to the spell's damage equal to the spell's rank.

Each time you Cast a Spell that has the vitality or [void](/trait/void) traits and that restores Hit Points while in this stance, the spells' targets gain a status bonus to the initial amount of healing received equal to the spell's rank. This bonus healing does not apply to healing over time effects (such as fast healing or regeneration).

name: Effect: Chosen Ward
descr:
Granted by [Chosen Ward](/feat/chosen-ward-war-of-immortals)

While either the origin or their united companion are adjacent to you, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC and Reflex saves.

name: Effect: Crash Against Me
descr:
Granted by [Crash Against Me](/action/crash-against-me-war-of-immortals)

You have resistance equal to your level to the chosen damage type.

name: Effect: Crash Against Me (Clang)
descr:
Granted by [Crash Against Me](/action/crash-against-me-war-of-immortals)

You are off-guard and take a –2 circumstance penalty to attacks with the clanging weapon.

name: Effect: Crash Against Me (Note)
descr: Granted by [Crash Against Me](/action/crash-against-me-war-of-immortals) via Ephemeral Effect

name: Effect: Creature of Myth (Energy Aegis)
descr:
Granted by [Creature Of Myth](/feat/creature-of-myth-war-of-immortals)

You become immune to the chosen damage type, and you gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saves that originate from creatures with the chosen trait and to effects and spells with the chosen trait.

name: Effect: Cry of Rebellion
descr:
Granted by [Cry Of Rebellion](/feat/cry-of-rebellion-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks.

name: Effect: Dancer in the Seasons
descr:
Granted by [Dancer In The Seasons](/feat/dancer-in-the-seasons-war-of-immortals)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

name: Effect: Destined Victory (Note)
descr: Granted by [Destined Victory](/feat/destined-victory-war-of-immortals) via Ephemeral Effect

name: Effect: Divine Invulnerability
descr:
Granted by [Divine Invulnerability](/feat/divine-invulnerability-war-of-immortals)

You gain resistance to all damage equal to half your level.

name: Effect: Divine Invulnerability (Domain Spell)
descr:
Granted by [Divine Invulnerability](/feat/divine-invulnerability-war-of-immortals)

You gain resistance to all damage equal to your level.

name: Effect: Don Thy Fervor
descr:
Granted by [Don Thy Fervor](/feat/don-thy-fervor-war-of-immortals)

You gain a circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation skill checks, and to counteract checks.

name: Effect: Drain Realm
descr:
Granted by [Drain Realm](/action/drain-realm-war-of-immortals)

Your Strikes deal an additional 1d8 damage of your realm's damage type.

name: Effect: Embody the Storm
descr:
Granted by [Final Scalecloak](/item/final-scalecloak-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +4 status bonus to AC against ranged projectiles that are at least partly made of metal.

name: Effect: Eye-Catching Spot
descr:
Granted by [Eye Catching Spot](/feat/eye-catching-spot-war-of-immortals)

You have a –1 circumstance penalty to melee attack rolls against the exemplar.

name: Effect: Feral Swing
descr:
Granted by [Feral Swing](/action/feral-swing-war-of-immortals)

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your Reflex save.

name: Effect: Fish From the Falls' Edge
descr:
Granted by [Fish From The Falls' Edge](/feat/fish-from-the-falls-edge-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 status bonus to your saving throws and AC.

name: Effect: Fly on Shadowed Wings
descr:
Granted by [Fly On Shadowed Wings](/feat/fly-on-shadowed-wings-war-of-immortals)

You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed and resistance to precision damage equal to your level.

name: Effect: Gird Champion (Hierophant)
descr:
Granted by [Gird Champion](/feat/gird-champion-war-of-immortals)

You treat the origin's favored weapon as a simple weapon for the purposes of proficiency, you gain the critical specialization effect of that weapon and deal 1d6 additional damage with Strikes made with it.

name: Effect: Godspeed
descr:
Granted by [Godspeed](/feat/godspeed-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds and are Quickened.

name: Effect: Harvest Blood
descr:
Granted by [Harvest Blood](/action/harvest-blood-war-of-immortals)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier, and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against that creature's spells.

name: Effect: Healer of the World
descr:
Granted by [Healer Of The World](/feat/healer-of-the-world-war-of-immortals)

You gain 10 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Heroic Defiance
descr:
Granted by [Heroic Defiance](/feat/heroic-defiance-war-of-immortals)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level and a +1 status bonus to all saving throws.

name: Effect: Invigorating Surge
descr:
Granted by [Invigorating Surge](/feat/invigorating-surge-war-of-immortals)

You gain temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Living Epic
descr:
Granted by [Living Epic](/feat/living-epic-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception, saving throws, and skill checks.

name: Effect: Lord of the Fiends
descr:
Granted by [Lord Of The Fiends](/feat/lord-of-the-fiends-war-of-immortals)

Whenever you roll a success on a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check against a fiend, you get a critical success instead.

name: Effect: Manifest Realm
descr:
Granted by [Manifest Realm](/action/manifest-realm-war-of-immortals)

You take a –1 penalty to Fortitude saving throws.

name: Effect: Mirrored Aegis
descr:
Granted by [Mirrored Aegis](/feat/mirrored-aegis-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Multifaceted Will
descr:
Granted by [Multifaceted Will](/feat/multifaceted-will-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against spells with the chosen tradition trait.

name: Effect: Mythic Allies
descr:
Granted by [Mythic Allies](/feat/mythic-allies-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +2 status bonus to your attack rolls, defenses, and a number of additional Hit Points equal to the origin's level. The next Strike you make gains a +4 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

name: Effect: Mythic Allies (Circumstance Bonus)
descr:
Granted by [Mythic Allies](/feat/mythic-allies-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll.

name: Effect: One Moment till Glory
descr:
Granted by [One Moment Till Glory](/action/one-moment-till-glory-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +2 status bonus to your saving throw.

name: Effect: Only You and I
descr:
Granted by [Only You And I](/action/only-you-and-i-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls made against the exemplar. Whenever you miss the exemplar with a Strike, they heal 1d8+5 Hit Points.

name: Effect: Pass Vengeful Judgment
descr:
Granted by [Pass Vengeful Judgment](/feat/pass-vengeful-judgment-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks against creatures in the area within a 10-mile radius of where Pass Vengeful Judgment was used.

name: Effect: Pierce the Eye
descr:
Granted by [Pierce The Eye](/feat/pierce-the-eye-war-of-immortals)

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to Medicine checks to Administer First Aid to stop the bleeding.

name: Effect: Prescience
descr:
Granted by [Prescience](/feat/prescience-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and all saves.

name: Effect: Race the Skies
descr:
Granted by [Race The Skies](/action/race-the-skies-war-of-immortals)

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

name: Effect: Raise the Walls
descr:
Granted by [Raise The Walls](/action/raise-the-walls-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC, Reflex saves, and any save against force, spirit, vitality, or void effect.

name: Effect: Relinquish Control
descr:
Granted by [Relinquish Control](/feat/relinquish-control-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +4 status bonus on saves against spells and effects that give you the [controlled](/condition/controlled-player-core) condition or attempt to influence your actions.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on all Recall Knowledge checks made using Lore skills granted by your attuned apparitions.

name: Effect: Roaring Heart
descr:
Granted by [Roaring Heart](/feat/roaring-heart-war-of-immortals)

You gain temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Shadow Sheath Weapon
descr:
Granted by [Shadow Sheath](/feat/shadow-sheath-war-of-immortals)

You load a weapon into the sheath.

**Immanence** Your Strikes with the weapon deal 2 additional spirit damage per weapon damage die, which increases to 3 per die if the target is off-guard.

name: Effect: Shadowpiercer
descr:
Granted by [Shadowpiercer](/item/shadowpiercer-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against darkness and shadow effects.

name: Effect: Share Hunter's Edge (Vindication)
descr:
Granted by [Animal Companion (Ranger)](/feat/animal-companion-ranger-player-core), [Shared Prey](/feat/shared-prey-player-core), [Triple Threat](/feat/triple-threat-player-core), [Warden'S Boon](/feat/warden-s-boon-player-core)

You gain a +1 status bonus to your spell attack rolls against the marked creature, and they take a –1 status penalty to their saving throws against divine spells you cast.

name: Effect: Shining Glory
descr:
Granted by [Shining Glory](/feat/shining-glory-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +3 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks, and the status bonus you receive to saving throws against fear increases to +3.

name: Effect: Smoky Protections
descr:
Granted by

You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Effect: Soul Vessel Mount
descr:
Granted by [Soul Vessel Mount](/feat/soul-vessel-mount-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +20-foot status bonus to your Speed.

name: Effect: Steal Death
descr:
Granted by [Steal Death](/feat/steal-death-war-of-immortals)

You gain fast healing as long as you and your apocalypse mount are within 10 feet of each other. If you use Steal Death again, your fast healing increases by 1.

name: Effect: Storied Companion
descr:
Granted by [Storied Companion](/feat/storied-companion-war-of-immortals)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice the origin's level.

name: Effect: Stymie the Gods
descr:
Granted by [Stymie The Gods](/feat/stymie-the-gods-war-of-immortals)

You gain a status bonus to AC and to saving throws against divine spells, as well as the spells, Strikes, and abilities of extraplanar creatures.

name: Effect: Survive the Wilds
descr:
Granted by [Survive The Wilds](/action/survive-the-wilds-war-of-immortals)

You and all allies in a 15-foot emanation gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against effects with the trait the pelt is attuned to.

name: Effect: Terrifying Mien
descr:
Granted by [Terrifying Mien](/feat/terrifying-mien-war-of-immortals)

You gain resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage against Strikes made by creatures with the [frightened](/condition/frightened-player-core) condition. This resistance is equal to four times the value of that creature's frightened condition.

name: Effect: The Proud
descr:
Granted by [The Proud](/feat/the-proud-war-of-immortals)

You take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks against creatures other than the exemplar, and a +1 status bonus to these rolls when targeting the exemplar.

name: Effect: To War!
descr:
Granted by [To War!](/feat/to-war-war-of-immortals)

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the origin's level and a +2 status bonus to damage against any foe damaged by the origin's apocalypse mount.

name: Effect: Towering Presence
descr:
Granted by [Towering Presence](/feat/towering-presence-war-of-immortals)

You increase your size your size to Large. Your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny), and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage.

name: Effect: Ultimatum of Liberation
descr:
Granted by [Ultimatum Of Liberation](/action/ultimatum-of-liberation-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +2 status bonus to Will saving throws against effects produced by the oppressing creature and their allies, which increases to +3 if they are within 30 feet of the origin.

name: Effect: Unbreaking Castle
descr:
Granted by [Unbreaking Castle](/feat/unbreaking-castle-war-of-immortals)

You gain a circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Unending Subsistence
descr:
Granted by [Unending Subsistence](/feat/unending-subsistence-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saving throws.

name: Effect: Victor's Wreath
descr:
Granted by [Victor'S Wreath](/feat/victor-s-wreath-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

name: Effect: Vindication Edge
descr:
Granted by [Vindicator](/feat/vindicator-war-of-immortals)

You take a –1 status penalty to their saving throws against divine spells.

name: Effect: Virulent Strike
descr:
Granted by [Virulent Strike](/feat/virulent-strike-war-of-immortals)

You take a –4 circumstance penalty to the save against a disease or poison.

name: Effect: Whose Cry is Thunder
descr:
Granted by [Whose Cry Is Thunder](/feat/whose-cry-is-thunder-war-of-immortals)

Any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon while you're charged takes 1d6 electricity damage.

name: Effect: Wither Away
descr:
Granted by [Wither Away](/feat/wither-away-war-of-immortals)

You take the following penalties depending on the result

**Arms** You become enfeebled 1.**Head** You become stupefied 1.**Legs** You take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.**Torso** You gain weakness 10 to slashing damage.

name: Effect: You Can't Kill an Idea
descr:
Granted by [You Can'T Kill An Idea](/feat/you-can-t-kill-an-idea-war-of-immortals)

Your Aid circumstance bonus increases by 1.

name: Effect: Zealous Inevitability
descr:
Granted by [Zealous Inevitability](/feat/zealous-inevitability-war-of-immortals)

You take a status penalty to your saving throws against divine spells equal to your doomed value.

name: Spell Effect: Arcane Explosion
descr:
Granted by [Arcane Explosion](/spell/arcane-explosion-war-of-immortals)

You gain the [incorporeal](/trait/incorporeal) trait, are immune to disease, poison, and precision damage, and gain resistance to all damage equal to your level (except force damage, spirit damage, and damage from Strikes with the *ghost touch* property rune), with double the resistance against non-magical damage.

name: Spell Effect: Devouring Dark Form
descr:
Granted by [Devouring Dark Form](/spell/devouring-dark-form-war-of-immortals)

You gain a tentacle unarmed attack with 10-foot reach that deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage and has the [grapple](/trait/grapple) trait.

---

**Heightened (2nd)** You can choose to take on the shark battle form from *animal form* instead of gaining a tentacle unarmed attack.

**Heightened (5th)** You can choose to take on the water elemental battle form from *elemental form* instead of gaining a tentacle unarmed attack.

name: Spell Effect: Diadem of Divine Radiance
descr:
Granted by [Diadem Of Divine Radiance](/spell/diadem-of-divine-radiance-war-of-immortals)

You shed bright light to a range of 60 feet and dim light to a further 60 feet.

name: Spell Effect: Discomfiting Whispers
descr:
Granted by [Discomfiting Whispers](/spell/discomfiting-whispers-war-of-immortals)

You must roll twice on your first attack roll and take the lower result.

name: Spell Effect: Embodiment of Battle
descr:
Granted by [Embodiment Of Battle](/spell/embodiment-of-battle-war-of-immortals)

You gain a status bonus to attack and damage rolls made with weapon or unarmed attacks, and you gain the Reactive Strike reaction; this reaction gains the [apparition](/trait/apparition) trait. You take a –2 status penalty to your spell attack modifiers and your spell DCs.

name: Spell Effect: Garden of Healing
descr:
Granted by [Garden Of Healing](/spell/garden-of-healing-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against emotion effects.

name: Spell Effect: Manifest Will
descr:
Granted by [Manifest Will](/spell/manifest-will-war-of-immortals)

You gain an effect depending on the spell's tradition, or the tradition selected with Multifaceted Will.

**Arcane** You gain weakness to spell damage equal to the spell's rank.**Divine** You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.**Occult** You gain lesser cover.**Primal** You have a –10-foot status penalty to all your Speeds.

name: Spell Effect: River Carving Mountains
descr:
Granted by [River Carving Mountains](/spell/river-carving-mountains-war-of-immortals)

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to each Speed you have.

name: Spell Effect: Traveling Workshop
descr:
Granted by [Traveling Workshop](/spell/traveling-workshop-war-of-immortals)

You are trained in Crafting and Thievery.

---

**Heightened (3rd)** Your proficiency in Crafting and Thievery is expert.

**Heightened (5th)** Your proficiency in Crafting and Thievery is master.

**Heightened (9th)** Your proficiency in Crafting and Thievery is legendary.

name: Spell Effect: Vindicator's Mark
descr:
Granted by [Vindicator'S Mark](/spell/vindicator-s-mark-war-of-immortals)

Your marked target takes additional damage from all your weapon or unarmed attacks.

name: Stance: Immovable Object
descr:
Granted by [Immovable Object](/feat/immovable-object-war-of-immortals)

While in this stance and on the ground, you are immune to forced movement and if an effect would knock you prone, you aren't knocked prone and can Step as a free action.

name: Stance: Spear of Doom
descr:
Granted by [Spear Of Doom](/feat/spear-of-doom-war-of-immortals)

Your cursed weakness is equal to your level instead of half your level.

name: Stance: Unified Stance
descr:
Granted by [Unified Stance](/feat/unified-stance-war-of-immortals)

When you enter this stance, your united companion gains the [quickened](/condition/quickened-player-core) condition and, when Commanded, can use the extra action to Stride or Strike.
